_comment: What the goods are decides the body type, hazmat handling, how bulky the load is and a price premium. Words are matched in Roman Hinglish and Hindi. kgPerCft is a typical packed density used to estimate volume when the broker gives only tons. Premiums and densities are working estimates for a pilot to tune.

hazardous.label: hazardous chemical
hazardous.note: Hazchem labels, UN number on the e-way bill and LR, driver with hazardous-goods training (TREM card), fire extinguisher; many owners refuse it.

perishable.label: perishable (needs a reefer)
perishable.hi: jaldi kharab hone wala maal (reefer chahiye)
perishable.note: Needs a refrigerated truck; the desk has no reefer owners yet, so hand it to the broker.

pharma.label: medicines / pharma
pharma.note: Closed body; ask whether temperature control is needed (vaccines and some drugs need 2-8 °C).

high_value.label: high-value goods
high_value.note: Closed container, transit insurance on the invoice value, a known owner.

textile.label: cloth / textiles
textile.note: Closed body (rain, theft); bulky, so volume can fill the truck before weight does.

steel_construction.label: steel / construction material
steel_construction.note: Open body or trailer is fine; heavy, so weight limits the truck.

agri.label: grain / agri produce
agri.note: Open body with tarpaulin is fine; in monsoon prefer closed.

machinery.label: machinery
machinery.note: Open body or trailer; check length, width and height (over-dimensional cargo needs permits) and crane loading.
